title: RLS Person Vocabulary
description: Profile fields for items representing a person. Used by Contacts / Profile views.

avatarUrl.description: Reference to a profile image. Legacy profile storage permits arbitrary non-empty strings; URI validation requires a future storage migration.

did.description: Optional stable identity used to bind person items to confirmations. A person item WITH a did is the projection of a profile; without one it is a stored placeholder (spec 04 §Profile, rule 5).

position.description: Where the person places herself. Opt-in and global: set in the profile, shown in every space alike (spec 04 §Profile, rule 4). A point — richer geometries belong to place/v1.
